title: Payment Processing | Borrower Collection & Lender Disbursement | Veteran Loan Servicing
description: How Veteran Loan Servicing processes commercial loan payments: ACH collection, reconciliation, scheduled lender disbursement, and full audit trails.
h1: Payment processing built on a reconcilable trail
lede: Collection and disbursement are the core of servicing. We run them as one defined sequence — collect, reconcile, disburse, report — so every dollar is traceable.

sections.heading: Process
paragraphs: Borrower payments are collected via ACH and disbursed to lenders on a scheduled monthly cycle, structured around NACHA operating guidelines, with a full audit trail maintained for every transaction.
The sequence is: collect on the scheduled cycle, reconcile each transaction against the loan ledger, disburse to lenders, and reflect the activity in reporting.
bullets: ACH collection on the scheduled cycle

sections.heading: Controls
paragraphs: Each transaction is reconciled and recorded. Because collection and disbursement run on the same ledger, the trail from a borrower payment to the corresponding lender disbursement is continuous rather than stitched across vendors.

sections.heading: Reporting
paragraphs: Disbursement activity appears in lender portfolio reporting, and the underlying transaction trail supports examiner and LP review on request.

sections.heading: Benefits
paragraphs: One continuous trail from collection to disbursement removes the reconciliation risk that comes from splitting payments across a ledger tool and a separate disbursement process.

faqs.q: How are borrower payments collected and disbursed?
faqs.a: Borrower payments are collected via ACH and disbursed to lenders on a scheduled monthly cycle, structured around NACHA operating guidelines, with a full audit trail maintained for every transaction.
Yes. ACH payment collection and lender disbursement are active, current operational capabilities.

faqs.q: Is Veteran Loan Servicing NACHA certified?
faqs.a: Veteran Loan Servicing structures its ACH payment processing around NACHA operating guidelines. NACHA does not certify individual companies; it publishes the operating rules that govern ACH transactions in the United States.
